cohort: 27,340 patients giving birth at the Hospital of St. Sofia in Warsaw between 2015-2020
finding: Epidural anesthesia was associated with an increased risk of episiotomy, perineal laceration and operative delivery, and a decreased risk of cesarean section.
mod_finding: Epidural anesthesia was associated with an increased risk of episiotomy, perineal laceration and operative delivery, and a decreased risk of cesarean section.
